newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's YPF, Perez Companc to build urea plant.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's YPF, Perez Companc to build urea plant.

text.p: Argentine oil company YPF SA said Monday it had formed a joint venture, called Profertil SA, with industrial conglomerate Perez Companc which will build a $470-million urea plant.
The new plant will produce one million tonnes of granulated urea a year for the fertilizer market, making it the biggest plant in the world of its type, YPF said.
The plant should come onstream in the second half of 1999 and will supply the Argentine market as well as produce an export surplus during its first years of operation.
The partners will supply the raw material for the plant with their own natural gas production, YPF said.
YPF did not say where the plant would be built.
